label: TPM3::ALK

sections.text: TPM3 encodes a tropomyosin isoform that associates with actin filaments.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.

The fusion retains the ALK kinase region and replaces normal receptor regulation with an amino-terminal partner, producing constitutive signaling. TPM3::ALK is a documented ALK fusion in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.
Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in adults and children aged at least 1 year.
